Is it necessary to cook the meat and invite relatives or u can distribut to relatives? I am living in london can i ask my parents to do aqqiqa for my son in pakistan? Question: Would you please explain about aqqiqa? Is it necessary to cook the meat and invite relatives or u can distribut to relatives? (2) I am living in london can i ask my parents to do aqqiqa for my son in pakistan? Answer ID: 1171 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 416/415=M) It is right to either distribute the meat of Aqeeqah or cook it and invite one's relatives to a feast: لان حکم العقیقۃ حکم الاضحیۃ It is not necessary to feed cooked meat. (2) Yes, you can do that Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
